title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 30-Inch Solid Brass Straight Bar | Satin Nickel | Que New Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom with a 30-Inch wall mount towel bar that keeps towels organized while saving space with a clean, straight-bar profile in Satin Nickel, which offers a warm, brushed finish that hides water spots and fingerprints, perfect for high-use bathrooms.

  • Satin Nickel coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
  • Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Clean installation: Concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Finish flexibility: , including statement colors
  • What’s included: Towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware

Specifications

  • Center-to-center: 30 inches
  • Overall dimensions: 33 inches W x 3 inches H
  • Projection: 3 inches
  • Bar diameter: 0.5 inches
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Weight capacity: 10 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4 in
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
